text:
keiko: Quick follow-up from the token postmortem — consolidating owners, deadlines, and a short verification cadence so this doesn't recur. Short thread, please ack ownership.
marcus: i'll take the validation patch + unit/e2e tests. filing INF-5017. target: Mon EOD for PR + staging tests.
laila: i'll own audit/logging changes: keep raw token traces 60d and add an ingestion-lag alert. PR target: Wed. log query i'll use: ```index=auth_prod source=token_validator status=FAIL | count by service, user```
alex: secrets rotation note — we need a scoped rotation for the token-verifier service account keys. i'll coordinate with infra; aiming for Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC window. will add KMS policy check in staging.
keiko: deployment plan: small canary then ramp. propose 10% for 12h -> 30% for 24h -> 100%. gate on token-fail-rate and 5xx spike. auto-rollback on gate fail. add synthetic ping every 2m.
marcus: agree. i'll add feature-flag + canary slicing in the PR. health gates: token_fail_rate <= baseline+0.75%, 5xx_delta < 0.2%.
laila: adding those gate thresholds to the alert playbook and will include a short runbook snippet in the PR (steps to triage token-fail anomalies).
alex: i'll run a pre/post rotation validation and post results in INF-5017. will also include a checklist to verify downstream consumers can access rotated keys.
keiko: ops cadence -> weekly check-ins Thursdays 09:30 for 3 weeks to confirm progress and review canary telemetry. @ops-bot make a recurring event in #incidents and DM reminders.
ops-bot: Recurring follow-up created: channel #incidents, every Thu 09:30, 3 occurrences. DM reminder to participants 20m before.
marcus: quick Q — do we want an explicit non-regression perf test for token validation latency? i can add a synthetic that asserts p95 < 120ms during canary.
keiko: yes please. add to perf CI and include a test vector set in INF-5017.
laila: also adding an audit pipeline integrity check: ingestion lag < 3m and checksum verification for batches; alert if mismatch. PR will contain alert snippet.
alex: final owners recap -> marcus (validation & tests INF-5017), laila (audit retention + alerts + runbook), alex/infra (scoped secrets rotation + KMS checks). Verification cadence -> Thu 09:30 x3, escalate to #eng-oncall if canary gates fail.
keiko: thanks all. i'll close the loop after the full ramp. if anyone hits blockers, ping #eng-oncall and @keiko directly. :white_check_mark:
